/-- Auxiliary converse of `RootHeld` (§40, §49.7), not a clause of `WF3`: an authority with no
origin is held by the owner of the root place of every leaf it covers. -/
def RootHeldConv (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (x : Nat) (z : Authority) (l r : Nat), s.A[x]? = some z → z.origin = none → l ∈ z.footprint →
    RootPlace s.P r → partOf s.P l r → ∃ pr, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ z.holder = pr.owner

/-! ## `WF3` (§49) -/

/-- `WF3(s)` (§49): one field per item of §49. Index order of parents and origins represents
acyclicity (§49, last paragraph). -/
structure WF3 (s : S3) : Prop where
  /-- §49.1: the stack is nonempty and duplicate-free, every frame below `nF`. -/
  frames : s.F ≠ [] ∧ s.F.Nodup ∧ ∀ f ∈ s.F, f < s.nF
  /-- §49.2: parent links are valid and acyclic (the parent precedes the child); a part shares
  its parent's owner and death marker. -/
  places : ∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (r : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.parent = some r →
    ∃ pr : Place, s.P[r]? = some pr ∧ r < q ∧ pr.owner = pl.owner ∧ s.dead r = s.dead q
  /-- §49.3: owner frames are below `nF`; owner places exist; the ownership chain of every usable
  place is finite and reaches a live frame. -/
  owners : (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (f : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .frame f →
      f < s.nF) ∧
    (∀ (q : Nat) (pl : Place) (o : Nat), s.P[q]? = some pl → pl.owner = .place o →
      o < s.P.length) ∧
    ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∃ f, FrameOf s q f ∧ f ∈ s.F
  /-- §49.4: footprints consist of leaves of existing places. -/
  footprints : ∀ (a : Nat) (x : Authority), s.A[a]? = some x → ∀ l ∈ x.footprint,
    l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §49.5: an existing origin precedes the authority, so origin chains are acyclic and end at a
  root authority. -/
  origins : ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a → a < b
  /-- §49.6: `RootChain`. -/
  rootChain : RootChain s
  /-- §49.7: `RootHeld`. -/
  rootHeld : RootHeld s
  /-- §49.8: every active authority is held by a frame of the stack or by a usable place. -/
  holders : ∀ (a : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[a]? = some y → y.active = true →
    HolderLive s y.holder

/-! ## `I1`–`I4`, `NoDangling`, `Inv3` (§50–§54, §57) -/

/-- `I1` (§50): two distinct active authorities unrelated by derivation covering a common leaf
both have own mode `Observe`. -/
def I1 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : Nat) (x y : Authority) (p : Nat), a ≠ b → s.A[a]? = some x → s.A[b]? = some y →
    x.active = true → y.active = true → p ∈ x.footprint → p ∈ y.footprint →
    a ∉ s.ancs b → b ∉ s.ancs a → x.mode = .observe ∧ y.mode = .observe

/-- `I2` (§51): the origin of a derived authority exists; the derived mode does not exceed the
origin's and the derived footprint is within the origin's. -/
def I2 (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (b : Nat) (y : Authority) (a : Nat), s.A[b]? = some y → y.origin = some a →
    ∃ x : Authority, s.A[a]? = some x ∧ y.mode.le x.mode ∧ ∀ p ∈ y.footprint, p ∈ x.footprint

/-- `I3` (§52): every anchor of a usable place is valid (active). -/
def I3 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ q, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, s.Active x

/-- `I4` (§53, first sentence): no read of a region containing a `Moved` leaf is permitted. -/
def I4 (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (l : Nat), l ∈ ls → s.I l = .moved →
  ¬ Read3Pre s a ls

/-- `I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4` (§57). -/
def Inv3base (s : S3) : Prop := I1 s ∧ I2 s ∧ I3 s ∧ I4 s

/-- `NoDangling` (§54): no active authority covers a leaf of an unusable place. -/
def NoDangling (s : S3) : Prop :=
  ∀ (j : Nat) (y : Authority), s.A[j]? = some y → y.active = true →
    ∀ q, ¬ s.Usable q → ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, l ∉ y.footprint

/-- `Inv3 = I1 ∧ I2 ∧ I3 ∧ I4 ∧ AnchorOrder ∧ NoDangling` (§57). -/
def Inv3 (s : S3) : Prop := Inv3base s ∧ AnchorOrder s ∧ NoDangling s

structure K where

/-- `DDSound(K)` (§80, §23): no declared disjointness relates two regions sharing a leaf. -/
def DDSound (k : K) : Prop := ∀ r r', k.DeclaredDisjoint r r' → ∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r'

/-- `origin` link of authority `i` (§42). -/
def cleanup (s : S3) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A.map fun y => if HolderLive s y.holder then y else { y with active := false } }

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- `endUse p` before releasing authorities whose holder died (§69, `ok` effect): the leaves of
`p` become `Uninit`; authorities held within `p` are released; anchors of `p` and its parts are
removed; storage owned by `p`, transitively, is marked dead. -/
def endUseS (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    I := fun l => if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l
    D := fun q => if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q
    dead := fun q => s.dead q || decide (OwnedIn s.P p q)
    A := s.A.map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y }

/-- Effect of `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): `endUseS`, then the authorities whose holder died
are released. -/
def endUseEff (s : S3) (p : Nat) : S3 := cleanup (endUseS s p)

/-- Leaf whose use ends with the value at `p` (§69.2, §69.4): a leaf of `p` or of storage that
stops being usable. -/
def EndingLeaf (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Prop :=
  l ∈ footprint s.P p ∨ (isLeaf s.P l ∧ s.Usable l ∧ ¬ (endUseS s p).Usable l)

/-- Decidability of `EndingLeaf` (§69). -/
instance (s : S3) (p l : Nat) : Decidable (EndingLeaf s p l) := by
  unfold EndingLeaf; infer_instance

/-- Root authority of the value at `p` (§69.3): an authority with no origin covering a leaf of
`p`. -/
def IsRootOf (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Prop :=
  y.origin = none ∧ ∃ l ∈ footprint s.P p, l ∈ y.footprint

/-- Decidability of `IsRootOf` (§69.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (p : Nat) (y : Authority) : Decidable (IsRootOf s p y) := by

I could not refute it. Every factual part of the claim checks out.

The current build is up to date (`lake build --no-build`: "All targets up-to-date (28 jobs)"). In the working tree, HandlePool.lean:515-517 now takes `(h1 : I1 s)`. HEAD:511-512 took `(ha : RootHeldConv s)`.

1. The old form does not follow from the new one. I copied incomparable.lean to recheck4/refute/ and it compiles; `#print axioms` gives [propext, Quot.sound]. I then built /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guygouri-Devlab-ernlang-ern/c986905c-e900-4fd9-bebc-4a3ce7ebb180/scratchpad/ref/recheck4/refute/full.lean, which compiles with axioms [propext, Quot.sound]. It closes a gap in the cited evidence, which did not check ContentEndPre or WF3'. On the same `sib` state, with q = 4, i = 2 and `Examples.K0`, it proves `WF3 sib ∧ NoDangling sib ∧ RootHeldConv sib ∧ ContentEndPre K0 sib 4 2 ∧ WF3 (endUseEff sib 4) ∧ ¬ I1 sib`. So all of HEAD's hypotheses can hold together while the new `I1` hypothesis fails. The swap is not a strengthening on its own.

2. No caller loses anything under KInv. oldforms.lean compiles, and every listed theorem has axioms [propext, Quot.sound]. It gets the NoDangling result from `KInv` alone, through `hk.2.1.1.1`. It also re-proves the HEAD forms of `contentEnd_preserves` and `freeSlot_preserves` from the new theorem pairs. The only caller of `contentEnd_noDangling` is HandlePool.lean:566, and it passes `hk.2.1.1.1`.

3. `#check @xreach_inv` matches the statement at HEAD:693-696.

4. The report never says this. fix4-pool.md lists the old and new signatures of `contentEnd_noDangling`, but grepping it for strength, incompar, narrow, weaker and stronger finds nothing. fix1-kernel.md:79-81 does say it for the analogous kernel lemmas: "is not a strengthening in isolation: the two hypotheses are incomparable."

The finding says the cause is a report omission, not a formalization error. That holds: blocking-report row B45 names the `rootHeldConv_active` route as the way to remove KAux, and the obligation theorem `contentEnd_preserves` is strictly stronger now. The finding's opening phrase "leaves out a statement change" is loose wording, because the signatures are in the report. What is missing is the note that the new form is not a strengthening.
